<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Makes an item of each entry of a list field, like a market's outcomes, with the other fields of the item it came from.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `transform.splitOut` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| List (`field`) | text | yes |  | The list to split, e.g. outcomes. An entry's own fields go at the top, beside the item's others. Names a field of the items it receives, a list one; saving checks the items have it. |

## Items

An item for each entry of the list **List** (`field`) names, with the other fields of the item it came from. An entry's own fields go at the top, in place of any of the same name; an entry that is not an object takes the list's place. An item whose list is empty or missing gives none.
